info.title: API.SH: Lemmy
info.description: The Lemmy API from API.SH: public Lemmy data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Comments of a post (flat, or as whole threads with `max_depth`), the replies under one comment, or the latest comments of a community or the instance: body, score, votes, reply count, depth, parent id, path, author, post and community. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lemmy-comments

parameters.name: include_nsfw
parameters.description: true to include posts, comments and communities marked NSFW (off by default).

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Lemmy instance to read from (host name, default lemmy.world), e.g. lemmy.ml, sh.itjust.works, programming.dev.

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Post id: that post's comments.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Comment id: the replies under that comment.

parameters.name: community
parameters.description: Community name: that community's latest comments (when no post_id/parent_id).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Instance-wide comments: All (default) or Local.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort (default Hot for a post, New otherwise).

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: With post_id or parent_id: return whole threads down to this depth (1-50); up to 300 comments a page and `limit` no longer applies.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Comments per page (1-50, default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
